1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_000020_THANCRED
1.description: 'Tis I. The situation may be more complicated than we anticipated.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_000040_URIANGER
3.description: Ere thou goest─another matter requireth thine attention. A young maiden, full eager to─

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_000050_URIANGER
4.description: Wherefore inquirest thou of her fairness!? Very well. Be she damsel or devil, I shall direct her steps to Revenant's Toll.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_000060_URIANGER
5.description: ...Save thine insinuations for one given to such impropriety. Thou shalt not find me amenable.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_000070_YUGIRI
6.description: (-???-)Far across the sea, from the land of Doma, have we traveled. We seek audience with the ruler of these lands. Who here speaks for you?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100010_YUGIRI
7.description: We have traveled some several thousand malms across the sea, from the nation of Doma, in hopes that we might find sanctuary in these lands.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100030_YUGIRI
9.description: Aye. Lying within Othard, Doma was under the dominion of the Garlean Empire, as I am sure you are aware.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100040_YUGIRI
10.description: When the war of succession broke out in Garlemald, we espied an opportunity to free ourselves from the yoke of imperial oppression, and took up arms.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100050_YUGIRI
11.description: ...Only to be crushed. And so I gathered what few Domans escaped the reckoning, and guided them hither to your shores.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100060_ALPHINAUD
12.description: A war of succession...? Then the Emperor... Forgive me, you said that Doma “was” under imperial rule, did you not?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100070_YUGIRI
13.description: Doma is gone. Razed to the ground as an example to the other provinces.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100080_ALPHINAUD
14.description: Twelve have mercy... And your people?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100090_YUGIRI
15.description: On a ship anchored in Vesper Bay, flying borrowed colors.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100100_YUGIRI
16.description: Many were complicit in the rebellion, or are kin to those who were. They will not come ashore until I send word that it is safe to do so.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100110_YUGIRI
17.description: I sought an audience with your rulers, but was summarily refused.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100120_ALPHINAUD
18.description: The lords of Ul'dah are not wont to entertain foreign refugees without suitable encouragement.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100130_YUGIRI
19.description: Mayhap I was foolish to expect otherwise. But our supplies run low, and we have young ones in urgent need of care.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100140_YUGIRI
20.description: I have seen the tents outside the gates, however. We are not the first to seek asylum, nor will we be the last.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100150_ALPHINAUD
21.description: ...Be that as it may, Ul'dah is no friend to Garlemald. Your tale would stir the hearts of many men and women here.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100160_ALPHINAUD
22.description: The sultana and the Syndicate will not be so easily swayed─but I shall see that you are granted an opportunity to plead your case.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100180_ALPHINAUD
24.description: Well...far be it from me to boast, but I do have the ear of certain influential individuals.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100200_ALPHINAUD
26.description: Lady Yugiri, forgive me for observing, but...your choice of attire seems like to evoke feelings of mistrust.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100210_YUGIRI
27.description: Men are wont to fear the unfamiliar. We know this from experience.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100220_YUGIRI
28.description: We seek only to spare the people of Ul'dah unnecessary disquiet.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100230_ALPHINAUD
29.description: I shall defer to your experience, then.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100240_YUGIRI
30.description: I thank you for your understanding.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_100250_ALPHINAUD
31.description: It seems I have urgent business with the Flame General. I leave our guests in your capable hands.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200000_YUGIRI
32.description: I, Yugiri of Doma, am honored to meet you at last, Your Grace. To mark this auspicious occasion, I should like to present to you the finest treasures our humble nation has to offer...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200010_YUGIRI
33.description: Alas, the circumstances which have brought me here today have divested me of both time and dignity. I come before you as a pauper in direst need of aid─to request that you grant my people asylum.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200020_NANAMOULNAMO
34.description: I, Nanamo, seventeenth in the line of Ul, welcome you to our city. Be at ease, Lady Yugiri.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200030_NANAMOULNAMO
35.description: Although I myself have heard the tale of your misfortune, I would ask that you recount it once more for the benefit of the others here present.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200040_YUGIRI
36.description: As you wish, Your Grace. For many years, my nation, Doma, suffered under the yoke of imperial rule, and my people yearned to be free. Thus, when a war of succession broke out in Garlemald, we sought to take advantage of the chaos and reclaim our liberty.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200050_YUGIRI
37.description: Alas, our enemy proved less preoccupied than we had hoped, and our rebellion was put down in the most brutal fashion.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200060_RAUBAHN
38.description: Those who survived─how many do they number?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200070_YUGIRI
39.description: More than two hundred souls huddle within the cramped confines of our own galleon's hold. Yet this figure accounts for but one of a number of ships which escaped the purge.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200080_YUGIRI
40.description: It is my hope that you will allow us all to dwell within your walls. Should that prove unfeasible, however, I humbly ask that you accept as many of my people as your resources allow.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200090_YUGIRI
41.description: Pray understand, we do not beg a boon, but propose instead an arrangement. We would serve─as soldiers or tradesmen─until our debt is repaid.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200100_RAUBAHN
42.description: What are the Syndicate's opinions on this matter?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200110_TELEDJIADELEDJI
43.description: I, for one, think it's a marvelous idea. Lady Yugiri and her people strike me as an industrious lot, and there are parts of the city which have yet to be fully restored. If they are willing to work, I see no reason not to let them.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200120_ALPHINAUD
44.description: The head of the Mirage Trust is not known for his generosity. He sees profit in this.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200130_RAUBAHN
45.description: I agree. That said, these are foreign refugees. To admit them would require a formal resolution. Shall we call a vote?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200160_LOLORITO
48.description: Tell me: are you blind or willfully ignorant? Even now, our streets are choked with the displaced victims of the Calamity and Ala Mhigan refugees.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200170_LOLORITO
49.description: They live hand-to-mouth, subsisting on aid provided by the Immortal Flames─the cost of which grows ever higher!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200180_LOLORITO
50.description: The wealth of Ul'dah is not without limits, my friends.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200190_LOLORITO
51.description: And need I remind you that these refugees are prone to violence and criminal activity? You have all read the reports, I think?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200200_LOLORITO
52.description: Without homes or employment, it is only a matter of time before men grow desperate and take that which they imagine has been unjustly denied them. Yet, knowing this, you would have us swell their ranks. Mayhap you think the Brass Blades and the Flames are not hard-pressed enough?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200210_ALPHINAUD
53.description: Some say the chairman of the East Aldenard Trading Company passes gil thrice daily. This may explain how he came to be the wealthiest man in Ul'dah. Or it may simply be that he's ruthless beyond reckoning.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200220_NANAMOULNAMO
54.description: Surely the sultanate can support the few hundred Domans Lady Yugiri represents? That our resources have been taxed I do not deny, but we are hardly in danger of financial collapse.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200230_NANAMOULNAMO
55.description: I move that an exception be made.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200240_LOLORITO
56.description: An exception, Your Grace? I am suddenly reminded of a similar debate some years ago, regarding a number of Ala Mhigan refugees, if memory serves.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200250_LOLORITO
57.description: What were your words that day? Ah, yes: “The law is the law.” And so our visitors remained in Little Ala Mhigo.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200260_LOLORITO
58.description: Mayhap our wise and benevolent sultana would be so good as to enlighten us as to which other of our laws should not be upheld?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200280_TELEDJIADELEDJI
60.description: My lord, I share your concern for the welfare of our great nation, but we must endeavor to take a longer view. You know as well as I that people can be a resource still more precious than gil.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200290_LOLORITO
61.description: Precious or not, they were never yet so reliable. And unlike those who frequent your establishment, I have no desire to gamble with my future.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200300_LOLORITO
62.description: Ul'dah's greatest asset is, and has ever been, her material wealth. We risk this at our peril.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200310_LOLORITO
63.description: One need only look to Teledji Adeledji's example for evidence of the danger in allowing sentiment to dictate policy.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200320_LOLORITO
64.description: How far the vaunted Mirage hath fallen, both in repute and profitability, since he began employing refugees...

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200330_TELEDJIADELEDJI
65.description: How I choose to conduct my affairs is not your concern, my lord!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200340_RAUBAHN
66.description: A proposal has been tabled. Given its urgency, I move we forgo further debate and call a vote.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200350_RAUBAHN
67.description: To accept the Doman refugees or not. Those in favor, I bid you remain. Those opposed, I bid you leave.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200360_NANAMOULNAMO
68.description: Would that it were within my power to welcome you and your people, Lady Yugiri. As you have observed, however, my authority in such matters is regrettably limited.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200370_NANAMOULNAMO
69.description: Without the consent of the Syndicate, I cannot act.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200380_YUGIRI
70.description: I understand, Your Grace. And I appreciate all that you have done on our behalf.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200390_TELEDJIADELEDJI
71.description: The nerve of the man... If that bastard had not forsaken the eastern trade route, Little Ala Mhigo would now be thriving.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200400_TELEDJIADELEDJI
72.description: That you should have traveled so far, under such dire circumstances, only to be refused in this manner is utterly unconscionable. Pray accept my sincerest apologies.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200410_RAUBAHN
73.description: Now that the Empire no longer poses an immediate threat, they see little reason to maintain the pretense of unity.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200420_RAUBAHN
74.description: The Monetarists have grown especially defiant of late─Lord Lolorito most of all.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_200430_RAUBAHN
75.description: But this is neither the time nor place for that discussion.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300010_THANCRED
76.description: How goes the fishing? Caught anything slippery?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300020_YSHTOLA
77.description: Aye. Our suspicions were well founded. The Serpent Reavers are indeed the culprits.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300040_YSHTOLA
79.description: Has there been any movement in Thanalan?

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300050_THANCRED
80.description: It has been blessedly quiet. Which is to say the Amalj'aa are being no more or less of a nuisance than usual, summoning Ifrit with such crystals as they have hoarded.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300060_THANCRED
81.description: Urianger, too, reports naught out of the ordinary.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300080_MINFILIA
83.description: Your explanation for what, pray tell?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300090_YSHTOLA
84.description: For the recent spate of crystal thefts in Thanalan. We naturally assumed that the trail would lead us back to the Amalj'aa.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300100_YSHTOLA
85.description: Yet it did not. It led us across the sea unto Vylbrand.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300120_MINFILIA
87.description: There <hex:021A020203>have<hex:021A020103> been reports of increased Sahagin activity of late...

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300130_MINFILIA
88.description: Oh gods...they mean to summon Leviathan?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300140_YSHTOLA
89.description: That is the way of it, I fear.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300150_YSHTOLA
90.description: Whilst conducting our investigation on behalf of the Mineral Concern, we came upon evidence implicating the Serpent Reavers.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300160_YSHTOLA
91.description: With the aid of the Maelstrom, I was able to verify our suspicions. 'Tis only a matter of time before Leviathan returns to harrow the seas.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_300170_YSHTOLA
92.description: But there is more. One of the Sahagin─an elder, by my judgment─spoke of attaining the “gift and knowledge of eternity.”

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_400010_YSHTOLA
94.description: Such a disturbance in the aether... If I did not know better, I should think this device defective.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_400030_WUUR
96.description: Soon! Sssoon it shall begin! Our Lord shall rise 'midst sssurging waves to wash away the finless ones!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_400040_WUUR
97.description: And I shall be granted the gift and knowledge of eternity, and with the emissary ssstand equal! Then shall I know no cesssation, no oblivion!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_400050_YSHTOLA
98.description: ...Whence comes this promise of immortality? The emissary?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500020_YSHTOLA
101.description: Are the two of you quite well?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500030_MINFILIA
102.description: You...you shared that vision, did you not?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500040_MINFILIA
103.description: Even before the Sahagin made mention of the emissary, I recognized Elidibus's words. <hex:021A020203>He<hex:021A020103> is behind this.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500050_MINFILIA
104.description: But surely it is not within his power to grant the Echo?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500060_YSHTOLA
105.description: My lady─unless we act swiftly, Leviathan will rise again. The Admiral has already requested that we intervene to prevent this. Failing that, we are to attend to the primal's extermination.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500070_MINFILIA
106.description: She will have our full cooperation. Let us make haste to Limsa Lominsa.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500080_MINFILIA
107.description: I mean to play a part in this mission. Tataru─pray take charge in my absence.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500090_THANCRED
108.description: My lady, are you sure this is wise?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500100_MINFILIA
109.description: I am aware of the risks. But there is something I must see with mine own eyes.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500120_THANCRED
111.description: Very well. I shall not stand in your way...on the condition that you permit me to accompany you as bodyguard.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500130_MINFILIA
112.description: Your company is ever welcome, Thancred.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500140_YUGIRI
113.description: I take it something ill is afoot?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500150_YSHTOLA
114.description: Aye. A primal is about to be loosed upon Eorzea.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500170_YSHTOLA
116.description: A godlike being whose very existence is a bane upon the land. We Scions of the Seventh Dawn are sworn to put an end to their kind.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500180_YUGIRI
117.description: I see. Know then that I am learned in the arts of war. In return for the kindness you have shown my people, I would lend you my blade.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500190_YSHTOLA
118.description: It would be most welcome. When contending with a primal, one can never have too many able allies.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_500200_YSHTOLA
119.description: If you crave a more intimate understanding of the problems facing Eorzea, this experience is like to provide it. Be sure to come well prepared.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_600010_YSHTOLA
120.description: Damn them... They have made thralls of soldiers and civilians both...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_600060_THANCRED
124.description: So that is how you fight in the Far East? Mental note: pick no quarrel with Domans.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_600070_THANCRED
125.description: But seriously: if I am to keep up, I must needs forsake elegance for efficiency.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700020_THANCRED
131.description: I've been something of a liability of late, I know. 'Tis high time I set about making amends.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700030_WUUR
132.description: Pshhh! Long have you shriveled shhhorewalkers tormented our kind!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700040_WUUR
133.description: But no more! Your time is at an end!

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700050_WUUR
134.description: You shall perish with sssalt in your wounds and sssea in your lungs!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700060_WUUR
135.description: Lord of the Whorl, hearken to our plea!<hex:02100103>Lord of the Whorl, deliver us from our misery!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700080_MINFILIA
137.description: I know this sensation... It's the Echo!

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700120_WUUR
141.description: Pshhhahahahahaaa! Ssstrike me down if you will! It is futile! I have massstered the gift! I am...<hex:021A020203>eternal<hex:021A020103>!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700130_WUUR
142.description: O mighty Leviathan, ruler of the ssseas, born of waters primordial! I offer unto You this frail fleshhh, that You might grant Your faithful servants deliverance!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700160_WUUR
145.description: Foolishhh shorewalker! You cannot kill that which is eternal!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700190_WUUR
148.description: Pshhh!? My being...ebbs away... B-But it should by rightsss be infinite!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700200_WUUR
149.description: Am I not...immortal? Curse you, Emissary! You promised me...everlasssting... Pshhh...

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700220_MERLWYB
151.description: What say you? Nary a single ship!? Hells take that sea demon!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700230_MERLWYB
152.description: Gather the survivors and get to shore. Leave the wrecks for the pirates.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700240_MERLWYB
153.description: Leviathan wastes no time. The diversionary squadron is lost.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700250_MERLWYB
154.description: For a mercy, 'twould seem the primal now makes for open sea. But why does he not press his advantage? Unless...

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_700260_MERLWYB
155.description: Gods save us, he means to unleash a tidal wave!

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800010_MERLWYB
156.description: There used to be a hamlet beyond South Tidegate in western La Noscea. Halfstone, 'twas called.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800020_MERLWYB
157.description: Some years prior to the Maelstrom's founding, Leviathan rose from the briny depths, and set about unleashing watery hell upon us. On that occasion, the Company of Heroes put him down before he could do too much damage.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800030_MERLWYB
158.description: But when the bastard came next, this time in the wake of the Calamity, we were not so fortunate. Weary of ravaging our shoreline, he summoned a tidal wave which fair leveled Halfstone, and washed the soil away for good measure.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800040_YSHTOLA
159.description: The area was subsequently occupied by the Sahagin.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800050_MERLWYB
160.description: Aye, the thrice-damned creatures transformed it into a spawning ground for their brood.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800060_MERLWYB
161.description: Given the quantity of crystals stolen to feed him and his legion of thralls, we can be fairly sure that Leviathan is stronger now than in his previous incarnations.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800070_MERLWYB
162.description: If that sea demon is left to wreak havoc, what befell Halfstone may well befall a larger settlement─even Limsa.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800080_MERLWYB
163.description: That <hex:021A020203>cannot<hex:021A020103> happen. The primal must be stopped.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800090_THANCRED
164.description: That was ever our objective, Admiral. But how are we to achieve it?

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800100_THANCRED
165.description: The sea is Leviathan's uncontested domain. The ships of the Third Squadron could not close to within a hundred yalms of the primal, nor could their cannons pierce his defenses.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800110_MERLWYB
166.description: I have read the reports, Master Thancred. Our warships may as well have been bloody pleasure barges for all the good they did. Seven hells... Is there no way that we might strike back?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800120_YSHTOLA
167.description: The Company of Heroes defeated Leviathan having first lured him into an inlet, but we must needs contend with him upon the open sea. It will avail us little to consult past experience.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800150_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
170.description: By all accounts, Leviathan's most formidable weapon is the very sea itself. Waves and whirlpools, tides and currents─all these things are his to command. The key to victory, I believe, lies in disarming our foe.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800160_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
171.description: This, in effect, is what the Company of Heroes achieved with their ruse. We cannot lure Leviathan from the sea a second time, but what if we could weaken his hold upon the element of water? I have heard of devices capable of such wonders. They draw upon the power of corrupted crystals, I am told.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800170_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
172.description: If mounted upon a ship, such a device might be used to prevent Leviathan from bringing the full force of the sea to bear against us, rendering him no more dangerous than any other sea serpent.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800180_MINFILIA
173.description: Of course... Cid built a similar device to grant the <hex:021A020203>Enterprise<hex:021A020103> safe passage through Garuda's tempest, did he not?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800190_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
174.description: Begging your pardon, my lady, but to give credit where it's due, this is something I heard from an old arcanist friend of mine.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800200_MERLWYB
175.description: It makes little difference who thought of it first, so long as it works. Beg the specifications of this device from your friend, and I shall pass them on to our people at Naldiq & Vymelli's.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800210_MERLWYB
176.description: But before we proceed any further, I would voice one concern: piercing Garuda's defenses is one thing, suppressing Leviathan's attacks quite another.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800220_MERLWYB
177.description: In matters of science, I am as a babbling babe, but I cannot well imagine that such a feat would be possible without a veritable mountain of corrupted crystals.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800230_MERLWYB
178.description: The question being: do we have a ship big enough to bear such a burden?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800240_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
179.description: Mayhap not, Admiral. But two might. Recall you the tale of Mistbeard's greatest haul? It is said that he lashed two ships together, side by side, the better to bear his plunder.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800250_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
180.description: By your leave, we might attempt to repeat the trick. The gods know, it would be quicker than building a new vessel.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800260_MERLWYB
181.description: Mistbeard did this? Truly, Marshal, upon the subject of the pirate king, you are as a scholar.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800270_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
182.description: Now, from what I have gleaned of these matters, the device will need to be in close and constant proximity to the target. To wit, we must lash our twin vessel to Leviathan.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800280_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
183.description: This in itself will be no small feat. Ramming speed will be required, but given the weight of the cargo, that will only be attainable with the aid of a towing vessel...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800290_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN
184.description: Suffice it to say, the task of piloting said vessel will entail considerable danger, and I would not ask it of another. I volunteer myself.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800300_MERLWYB
185.description: 'Twill be dangerous for all involved...but we have no better recourse. Very well.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800310_MERLWYB
186.description: Commodore. Assemble the remnants of the fleet at Moraby Bay.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800320_MERLWYB
187.description: Give priority to our soundest vessels. The repairs can wait.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800330_MERLWYB
188.description: Storm Marshal Slafyrsyn, command of the operation is yours. I want that twin vessel ready to sail posthaste.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_800350_MERLWYB
190.description: And then there is the small matter of slaying the beast... The fate of Limsa Lominsa rests upon your shoulders once again. Go well, Warrior of Light.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900010_MERLWYB
191.description: We Lominsans are sworn to strive “Till sea swallows all”─and swallow all it would have, had Leviathan prevailed. That we still strive now, we owe in no small part to you.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900020_MERLWYB
192.description: Not for the first time, you have delivered Limsa Lominsa from the wrath of a primal. Never has our nation known a stouter ally.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900030_MERLWYB
193.description: On behalf of my people, I give you my humblest thanks.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900040_MERLWYB
194.description: 'Tis meet that I give thanks to old Mistbeard, too, for his fine solution. Whatever else he may have been, 'tis clear he was a resourceful soul. Would that I had a man like him in my service.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900050_YUGIRI
195.description: Before I set foot in these lands, I had no inkling that the people of Eorzea contended with such mighty foes. Suffice it to say, their existence came as something of a shock─as did the idea that they could be defeated.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900060_YUGIRI
196.description: This experience has served to remind me of the vastness of the world...and the boundless potential of man.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900070_YUGIRI
197.description: Though I am but a refugee in this realm, I would fain be of use to you in your fight.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900080_YUGIRI
198.description: Know that I am tutored in one of the foremost combat arts of the Far East. It may seem...outlandish to the Eorzean eye, but should any of your people care to learn, I would be pleased to initiate them.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900090_MERLWYB
199.description: And I will see to it that they are grateful. I have no doubt that your knowledge and skills will serve us well.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900100_MERLWYB
200.description: Besides, your art is not so outlandish as you think. Would you not agree, Master Thancred?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900110_THANCRED
201.description: Naught escapes your searching eye, Admiral.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900120_THANCRED
202.description: Few are privy to this information, but Limsa Lominsa is home to a certain...secret fraternity. Its members are trained in a form of combat not unlike your own.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900130_THANCRED
203.description: By my judgment, it should not be beyond such individuals to adapt to the techniques I witnessed you employing with such admirable deftness.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900140_YUGIRI
204.description: I am heartened to hear this. I, too, noted a kinship between your style and mine own. Though it seemed to me that you fought differently in the beginning.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900150_THANCRED
205.description: A-Aye, I suppose I did... What can I say? I am a man of many talents. Hahaha...

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900160_YSHTOLA
206.description: Though you may labor to believe it, Thancred was once something of a scoundrel, who fraternized with the criminal class in these parts.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900180_MINFILIA
208.description: But for a chance encounter with Alphinaud's grandsire, he might never have left Limsa Lominsa; or received an education in Sharlayan; or taken up his post in Ul'dah─which is where he trained in the blade, lest you wonder.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900200_YUGIRI
210.description: It would seem there is more to you than meets the eye, Master Thancred.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900210_MERLWYB
211.description: Lady Yugiri─I am told that you and yours came to Eorzea seeking permanent resettlement, and that many Domans have since been engaged as frontier hands at Revenant's Toll. Mor Dhona is many things, but a place of refuge it is not.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900220_MERLWYB
212.description: Know that I would like nothing better than to furnish your people with a new home here on Lominsan soil. Alas, racked by instability as we are, our nation is in no fit state to take you in.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900230_MERLWYB
213.description: Yet I'll not have it said that we turned a blind eye to your suffering. Until such time as we can do more, I pledge to send provisions.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900240_YUGIRI
214.description: We are in your debt, Admiral. I realize that it scarce qualifies as repayment, but if it please you, I shall set about sharing my martial knowledge with your people at once.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900250_MERLWYB
215.description: You wished a word in private.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900260_YSHTOLA
216.description: The better not to spoil the festive mood.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900270_YSHTOLA
217.description: History repeats itself, Admiral. As the kobolds did before them, the Sahagin resorted to summoning their god over a territorial feud. They acted in self-preservation.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900280_YSHTOLA
218.description: It may be that the Sahagin initiated this particular clash, but how it begins does not interest me so much as how it ends.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900290_MERLWYB
219.description: I have not forgotten our conversation, Y'shtola. I am aware that man bears part of the blame for the primals' existence.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900300_MERLWYB
220.description: Nor am I ignorant of the Sahagin's reason for acting. They sought to secure a place to breed and multiply, that their kind might survive. Self-preservation, as you say.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900310_MERLWYB
221.description: But we have as much right to live and thrive as they. If our own survival is threatened, are we to lay down our arms and welcome oblivion? Nay.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900320_YSHTOLA
222.description: And so you kill, that you might live. Yet if living is a right, then that right belongs to all peoples, be they men or beastmen.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900330_MERLWYB
223.description: I'll not deny your reasoning. But when a storm gathers, it falls to me to see my people safely through it. That is my duty, and I shall do it.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900340_YSHTOLA
224.description: As must we all, Admiral. Stay the course, then, but know that it will lead to no good end.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900350_YUGIRI
225.description: Man has ever put himself first and foremost.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900360_YUGIRI
226.description: To justify his actions, he clads himself in the armor of righteousness─though it be a fancy of his own making. In this, mayhap the Garleans and we Domans are not so different...

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900370_MERLWYB
227.description: Eorzea has become as a raging sea. If we are to keep our heads above the waves, we cannot scruple to drown the man next to us.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_900380_MERLWYB
228.description: When hopes of coexistence founder, strength must determine who has the greater right to live.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00010_MINFILIA
229.description: I have been reflecting upon the events which took place during our visit to Vylbrand.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00020_MINFILIA
230.description: If you have a moment, I would share my conclusions with you. Please bear with me.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00030_MINFILIA
231.description: When the Sahagin elder summoned Leviathan, he employed the power we have come to know as the Echo.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00040_MINFILIA
232.description: Though I cannot well explain the how of it, it would seem he became immortal in so doing.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00050_MINFILIA
233.description: When the Admiral subsequently slew him, his spirit emerged from his lifeless flesh, a consciousness shorn of physical form.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00060_MINFILIA
234.description: Thus transfigured, he took up residence in the body of his minion with the ease of a man donning a favorite glove.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00070_MINFILIA
235.description: Long have I known that the Echo allows one to pass through the walls of a man's soul.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00080_MINFILIA
236.description: But never did I imagine that it could free us from our own flesh, nor less that our souls could then occupy the next corporeal vessel to take our fancy.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00090_MINFILIA
237.description: It was of this that Elidibus spoke─an existence which knows neither cessation nor oblivion.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00100_MINFILIA
238.description: And yet, though the Sahagin had mastered his gift and thereby become immortal, he was by no means invulnerable.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00110_MINFILIA
239.description: As we both bore witness, he was ultimately absorbed into Leviathan.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00120_MINFILIA
240.description: And the import of this observation? If the Ascians' mode of existence is indeed the same, it can be inferred that they, too, are not invulnerable─that they <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> be destroyed.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00130_MINFILIA
241.description: There exists a legend which tells of souls who are reborn upon the cusp of each Umbral Calamity, that they might stay the encroaching Darkness.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00140_MINFILIA
242.description: To most, it is but a faerie tale, yet recent events have given me cause to wonder: could the legend in fact refer to the Echo?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00150_MINFILIA
243.description: Much and more yet remains unknown, but I am confident that all will become clear in time.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00160_MINFILIA
244.description: For the present, however, what matters is that the key to defeating the Ascians may at last be within sight.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00170_MINFILIA
245.description: With Urianger's aid, it is my hope that I shall fathom this matter ere long.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00180_MINFILIA
246.description: Ah! I was just about to send for you, my friend.<hex:02100103>...Is aught amiss?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00190_URIANGER
247.description: Grave tidings from the Sharlayan motherland, my lady.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00200_URIANGER
248.description: It doth concern our distant allies, the Students of Baldesion.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00220_URIANGER
250.description: My lady...the Isle of Val, which for many years hath been the order's home, is no more.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00230_MINFILIA
251.description: No more? Whatever do you mean?

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00240_URIANGER
252.description: I relate only that which hath been conveyed unto me by our agents. An aetheric wave of the highest magnitude was recorded in the region. Soon thereafter, 'twas observed that the isle had ceased to be.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_A00250_URIANGER
253.description: 'Tis postulated that a magick was evoked, like in power to Ultima.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_B00010_LOLORITO
255.description: If there are no other matters, I move that today's meeting be adjourned.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_B00030_FOLLOWEROFTELEDJI
257.description: I... <cough> F-Forgive my impertinence, my lord, but these orders... I am uncertain as to what end they serve.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02200_C00020_GILGAMESH
260.description: That's enough of a beating for now!
